items.explanation: The dirge 'Fear no more the heat o' the sun, / Nor the furious winter's rages' from Shakespeare's Cymbeline (Act IV, Scene 2) recurs throughout Virginia Woolf's Mrs Dalloway (1925), linking Clarissa Dalloway and the shell-shocked veteran Septimus Warren Smith.
